title: Droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing of paraformaldehyde-fixed cells
protocol: Remove the glass bulb from an Aquapel Glass Treatment Applicator.
Fill a BD 3 ml Luer-Lok syringe with Aquapel.
Inject Aquapel to the chip through the cell inlet.
Incubate the chip at room temperature for 2-3 minutes.
Blow air through the bead inlet to dry the chip.
Cover the chip inlets with Scotch Tape.
Let the chip rest at room temperature overnight before use.
Discard unused Aquapel.
Prepare wash buffer: PBS with 1% BSA and 40 U/ml RNase inhibitor.
Wash cells once with 1 ml of 1% BSA in PBS using centrifugation setting 400g for 5 minutes.
Add 1 ml of 4% PFA in PBS to the cells, and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Spin cells at 400g for 5 minutes, discard PFA, and wash once with 1 ml of wash buffer.
Proceed to permeabilization if needed, or directly to FD-seq. Cells can be stored in wash buffer at 4°C overnight.
Permeabilize cells by adding 500 ul of 0.1% Triton X-100 (diluted in wash buffer) to the cell pellet, and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add 1 ml of wash buffer to the cells, spin 400g for 5 minutes, and discard supernatant.
Wash the cells once more with 1 ml of wash buffer.
Prepare 0.01% BSA by mixing molecular biology grade BSA in PBS, preparing at least 10 ml per sample.
Count Drop-seq beads by adding 20 μl of beads to 20 μl of 20% Ficoll and pipetting the mixture to a Fuchs-Rosenthal hemocytometer.
Add 50 μl of 1M DTT and 50 μl of 800 units/ml proteinase K for every 1 ml of lysis buffer, prepare 2 ml per sample, filter with a 40 um cell strainer, and store on ice.
Wash the PFA-fixed cells 2-3 times each with at least 2 ml of 0.01% BSA.
Filter the cells using an appropriate cell strainer, count the cells, and resuspend the cells at 100,000 cells/ml in 0.01% BSA, preparing at least 1.2 ml per sample.
Resuspend Drop-seq beads in lysis buffer (with DTT and proteinase K added) at 120,000 beads/ml, and store on ice.
Add Bio-Rad oil into a BD 10 ml Luer-Lok syringe.
Add cells into a BD 3 ml Luer-Lok syringe.
Insert a magnetic disc into a BD 3 ml Luer-Lok syringe, and add beads to the syringe.
Place the cell, bead, and oil syringes on a syringe pump.
Connect the syringes to a Droplet Generation Microfluidic Chip via needles and tubings.
Use a magnetic stirrer to gently mix the bead syringe.
Set the flow rates of cell, bead, and oil syringe pumps to 3, 3, and 12 ml/h respectively.
Start the pump in the order: cell, then bead, then oil.
Collect droplets in a 50 ml centrifuge tube for approximately 20 minutes per sample.
Inspect the Chip's droplet generation junction to ensure stable generation process.
Plate the 50 ml centrifuge tube with the droplets on a heat block and incubate at 56°C for 1 hour.
Carefully remove the tube from the heat block, then leave it at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Put the tube on ice for 5 minutes.
Pipette approximately 15 μl of oil and 5 μl of droplets into an FD hemocytometer.
Visually check that most droplets contain at most one bead per droplet.
Remove as much oil from the 50 ml tube as possible, without disturbing the droplets.
Add 30 ml of 6X SSC to the droplets.
Add 1 ml of Perfluorooctan-1-ol into the tube inside a chemical hood.
Close the tube tightly.
Shake the tube vertically by hands 4 times.
Spin the tube at 1000g for 1 minute.
Transfer approximately 30 ml of the supernatant above the oil interface to a new 50 ml centrifuge tube.
Add 30 ml of 6X SSC to the old 50 ml tube.
Wait for approximately 2-3 seconds, then transfer 30 ml of the supernatant above the oil interface to another new 50 ml tube.
Spin both new 50 ml tubes at 1000g for 3 minutes.
Discard the supernatant from both tubes.
Pool the beads at the bottom of the two tubes into a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.
Wash the beads twice with 1 ml of 6X SSC.
Wash the beads once with 300 ul of 5X Maxima H- RT buffer (Thermo Fisher, cat EP0753).
Use centrifuge settings of 1000g and 1 minute for each wash step.
Discard supernatant after washing.

Add 200 μl of RT mix to the beads: 80 μl nuclease free water, 40 μl 5X Maxima H- RT buffer, 40 μl 20% Ficoll, 20 μl 10 mM dNTPs (NEB, cat N0447S), 5 μl RNase inhibitor (NEB, cat M0314L), 5 μl 100 uM TSO_RNAhybrid, 10 μl Maxima H- reverse transcriptase (Thermo Fisher, cat EP0753).
Incubate the beads at room temperature for 30 minutes with rotation.
Incubate the beads at 42°C for 1.5 hours with rotation.
Spin the beads and discard the supernatant.
Wash once with 1 ml TE-SDS.
Wash twice with 1 ml TE-TW.
Wash once with 10 mM Tris pH 8.0.
Discard supernatant after washing.
Add 200 ul of Exo I mix to the beads: 170 ul nuclease free water, 20 ul 10X Exo I buffer, 10 ul Exo I (NEB, M0293S).
Incubate at 37°C for 45 minutes with rotation.
Spin the beads and discard the supernatant.
Wash once with 1 ml TE-SDS.
Wash twice with 1 ml TE-TW.
If proceeding immediately to whole transcriptome amplification, resuspend the beads in 1 ml nuclease free water.
If not proceeding immediately, store the beads in 1 ml TE-TW at 4°C.
When ready for WTA, resuspend the beads in 1 ml nuclease free water.
Count the beads as described in the "Set up for droplet generation" section.
Resuspend the beads in water such that the bead concentration is at most 5,000 beads per 24.6 ul.
Distribute beads into a 96-well plate, such that each well contains 5,000 beads in 24.6 ul nuclease free water.
Set up 50 ul PCR reaction: 24.6 ul of water and beads, 0.4 ul 100 uM TSO_PCR primer, 25 ul Kapa HiFi Readymix (Roche, cat 7958935001).
Thermal cycling program: 95°C 3 min; 4 cycles of 98°C 20s, 65°C 45s, 72°C 3 min; 10 cycles of 98°C 20s, 67°C 20s, 72°C 3 min; 72°C 5 min; 4°C hold.
Equilibrate Ampure XP beads (Beckman Coulter, cat A63880) at room temperature for 15-30 minutes.
Add 10 μl nuclease-free water into each WTA well, pipette mix and spin the plate at 1000g for 1 minute.
Pool 50 μl from each WTA well into a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.
Add the equivalent of 30 μl Ampure beads per well to the pooled solution and mix well.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes, then place on a magnetic rack.
Wait 5 minutes for the beads to collect, discard the supernatant, and wash the beads four times with 1 ml of 80% ethanol.
Remove ethanol after each washing step and let the beads dry for 5 minutes.
Elute the beads in the equivalent of 10 μl nuclease-free water per well and mix well.
Incubate the eluted solution at room temperature for 5 minutes, then place on a magnetic rack again.
Wait at least 3 minutes to separate supernatant from beads, then transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube without disturbing the beads.
Store the purified WTA products at -20°C.
Quantify the purified WTA products using Qubit.
Start a thermal cycling program for a 55°C hold and prepare a 20 μl PCR volume.
Prepare 2 tagmentation reactions on ice, using a PCR strip or 96-well plate.
Add 10 μl of Tagment DNA mix to the WTA products.
Pipet mix.
Spin the samples down quickly.
Incubate on a preheated thermal cycler at 55°C for exactly 5 minutes.
Place the samples on ice after 5 minutes.
Add 5 μl of neutralization (NT) buffer.
Pipet mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place them on ice.
Add 8 μl nuclease-free water to the samples.
Add 1 μl 10 uM P5-TSO primer.
Add 1 μl 10 uM Nextera_N7XX index primer.
Add 15 μl Nextera PCR master mix.
Thermal cycle the samples at 95°C for 30 seconds.
Cycle the samples through 12 cycles of 95°C for 10 seconds, 55°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 30 seconds.
Incubate the samples at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Hold the samples at 4°C.
Perform Ampure XP bead purification with a 0.6X bead ratio.
Store the purified tagmented library at -20°C.
Quantify the library with BioAnalyzer.
Denature the library according to the manufacturer's guideline.
Use custom read 1 primer.
Perform single index, paired end sequencing: read 1 = 20bp, read 2 = 60 bp, index 1 = 8 bp.
